iphone.2: Scroll down, tap Add to Home Screen
iphone.3: Tap Add, then open World Zero from its new icon

android.1: Tap ⋮ at the top right of Chrome
android.2: Tap Install app (some phones say Add to Home screen)

settings.action: Put World Zero on your home screen

ask.title: Can I live on your home screen?
ask.bodyIphone: Right now I just hover near your browser tabs. Give me an icon and I'll keep a door open: one tap back in, the whole screen, and the only way an iPhone lets me knock when someone rates your praxis.
ask.bodyAndroid: Right now I just hover near your browser tabs. Give me an icon and I'll keep a door open: one tap back in, the whole screen, and a way to knock when someone rates your praxis.
ask.footIphone: Three taps in Safari. I'll do the pointing.
ask.footChrome: One tap. Chrome asks you to confirm.
ask.footManual: Two taps in Chrome's menu. I'll do the pointing.

share.title: Tap Share
share.body: The square with an arrow, in Safari's bar at the bottom. On newer iPhones it hides under ••• first.

add.title: Tap Add to Home Screen
add.body: Scroll the share list down a little. It's the row with a plus in a square.

tapAdd.title: Tap Add
tapAdd.body: Top right of the next screen. Then look for me on your home screen.

done.title: Open me from your home screen
done.body: This browser tab can go. Next time, come in through my door.

manual.title: Tap ⋮, then Install app
manual.body: The three dots sit at the top right of Chrome. Some phones call it Add to Home screen instead.

installed.title: I'm the WØ on your home screen
installed.body: Chrome's own Install box comes up between the last screen and this one. Open me from the icon next time.

later.title: No rush.
later.body: It waits in Settings › Notifications, whenever you want it.

reask.title: Someone rated your praxis. I knocked.
reask.body: Nobody heard. {{why}} Move me onto your home screen and next time you'll hear it.
reask.whyIphone: Safari won't open the door for me.
reask.whyAndroid: I can only knock from the home screen.
reask.stopTitle: Got it. I won't ask again.

welcome.title: Oh, it's NICE in here.
welcome.body: Thanks for the room, {{name}}. Now I can actually knock: when someone rates your praxis, I'll tap on the glass.
welcome.bodyNoName: Thanks for the room. Now I can actually knock: when someone rates your praxis, I'll tap on the glass.
welcome.foot: Your phone asks right after this. That one is the real switch.
welcome.yesBody: That's the sound. Only for things about you, like a rating or a letter.
welcome.noTitle: Fair. I'll sit by the door.
welcome.noBody: Knocks turn on any time in Settings › Notifications.
